property_summary: Rule: Only the original deployer (the stored admin) can successfully change the contract's owner via setOwner; the mutant that compares msg.sender to owner instead of admin allows calls by the current owner (when different from admin) to change owner, so there exist fuzzed caller and newOwner addresses that make the mutant change owner while the reference does not.
change_summary: Modify onlyAdmin modifier to check against owner instead of admin, allowing calls by owner and leading setOwner to behave differently when msg.sender equals owner but not admin.
